speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancreatic Cancer (Head of Pancreas).

The ultrasound confirms an anechoic cystic mass in the subhepatic region causing obstruction of the bile ducts, which explains your jaundice, pale stools, and dark urine. Given your age, significant weight loss, and painless jaundice, this is highly suspicious for malignancy. Would you like me to order a CT scan of the abdomen to further characterize this mass?
